shared_elements: single large human or humanoid figure occupying the whole vertical field
carved stone surface in low relief
head with elaborate hair/headdress at the top
circular disc or rosette motif on the body/arm
horizontal banded or belt-like divisions across the torso
hands/arms brought across the chest holding or resting on objects
justification: Both are tall stone monuments dominated by one anthropomorphic figure with a distinctly treated head at the top, banded torso and a prominent circular disc motif on the body, which is the most specific correspondence. However, A is a heavily eroded, near-sculptural block with schematic, barely legible frontal forms, while B is a crisp, finely detailed profile relief on a flat slab with articulate anatomy, drapery and hair texture — a wholly different manner of carving and viewpoint.
